Components / Lib

URL helpers

The one place a source URL becomes display parts and an open decision: no-throw hostname extraction (the web's bare new URL() throws take transcripts down; this falls back) and the http/https scheme allowlist guarding the Linking.openURL hop that replaces the web anchor's target=_blank. Backs sources and inline-citation.

  • v0.2.1
  • lib
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/url.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/url.json

No required npm packages — this item installs through the registry dependencies below.
